blockers.problem: Lines 41-47 still say the host approval UI is the only trusted grant and that the methodology stores no local approval ledger. The candidate adds a local Codex approval store (~/.claude/itd-codex-approvals/) whose grant is not given through the host UI, so the normative contract contradicts itself.

record_approvals skips the hash when a record already exists (O_EXCL -> FileExistsError -> continue). After the 30-minute TTL expires, a repeat ITD-APPROVE of the same hash is silently ignored: consume_approval spends the expired record and denies the call, so the user's explicit approval is lost. No test covers re-approval after expiry.
